profile.headline: Your favorite coworker’s favorite coworker
profile.summary: Software engineering leader with 19+ years of experience. Thought-leader and innovator with over 29 patents and counting. As part of Walmart's People.AI organization, I'm helping to accelerate the use of AI technologies across all Walmart associates, enhancing their experiences every day. DM me with your favorite uses of generative AI.

positions.title: Senior Distinguished I, Software Engineer
positions.description: As part of the People.AI organization, I'm helping to accelerate the use of AI technologies across all Walmart associates, enhancing their experiences every day.

positions.title: Distinguished Engineer
positions.description:
Architected and led a full-stack redesign of Sonos.com handling millions of daily users and reduced page latencies by 56% from ~2.3s to ~1.3s. Modernized the website using Next.js, React, Typescript, CSS-in-TS, AWS CDK, Lambda, Dynamodb, and GraphQL via AppSync. The architecture consisted of a micro frontend, component library, microservice backend, and full CI/CD using GitHub Actions. Implemented a new CMS with Sanity.io to provide more flexibility for the marketing team. Utilized incremental static regeneration of pages for increased fault-tolerance.
Acted with Technical Product Manager responsibilities to drive the end-to-end integration of a third-party subscriptions platform to enable hardware-as-a-subscription on Sonos.com. Architected and led the project to successful and timely completion.
Strategic partner to the Marketing organization helping with 5-year operating plans and business roadmaps. Contributed website innovations such as personalized content and offers, and strategies to leverage AI/Generative AI.
Provided tier-1 support during website outages; led the subsequent root cause analysis reports and drove action items to prevent recurrence.

positions.title: Principal Engineer
positions.description:
Led new product initiatives to drive e-commerce revenue including a loyalty program that was responsible for $29M in increased revenue in FY24. Architected and implemented scalable full-stack solutions (Commerce Cloud, HTML, JS, CSS, .NET, SQL Server).
Led a migration to decouple a monolithic .NET service to microservices using AWS lambdas. Uses AWS CDK (infrastructure-as-code) to deploy.
Implemented and internally launched a React/Typescript web controller for Sonos systems. This was the basis for the eventual launch of play.sonos.com.
Launched a metrics dashboard, aggregating across millions of rows of data, allowing users to visualize their speaker usage with a gamification aspect.

positions.title: Manager, Software Development, Site Reliability Engineering
positions.description:
Hired, developed, and led an organization of 25 (18 SDEs, 4 TPMs, 3 SDMs) across four teams: Availability, Fatals, Resilience, and Latency/Performance. Collaborated across VP-level organizations to drive engineering best practices across the Retail and AWS spaces.
Owned the company-wide COE (correction of errors; aka root cause analysis) process.
Owned and actively participated in the Call Leader program, a rotation of high-level engineers who engaged on and helped mitigate severity-1 issues.
Oversaw the implementation of a near-real-time anomaly detection system (using Kafka) across all website requests; aggregated and analyzed trends across thousands of data points per second.
Owned and maintained a company-wide service configuration “linter” (called Policy Engine) to audit against known anti-patterns.
Owned and maintained a chaos engineering tool (called Gremlin) used to warn service owners of potential points of failure.
Led the successful execution of the first two Prime Day events in 8 marketplaces worldwide across 200+ service owners.
Drove the reduction of website outage minutes year over year; led Amazon.com through an outage-free Black Friday and Cyber Monday for three consecutive years (2012-2014)
Led the implementation of a system to visualize service metrics and alarm on anomalies helping to drive website “fatals” down by more than 50% year over year in 2013.
Wrote weekly executive summaries to C-level leadership reporting on program status across our Availability, Fatals, and Latency programs.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Team lead on internal trouble ticketing and change management systems (built the custom front-end on top of headless Remedy)
Provided tier-1 support for Target.com on Amazon’s Merchant Platform
Designed and implemented a pluggable, company-wide dashboarding solution to monitor the health of websites and services
